title: Open Robotics RViz IntensityPCTransformer PointField Out-Of-Bounds Read Denial-of-Service… (CVE-2026-134047)
description: A denial-of-service vulnerability exists in Open Robotics RViz within the IntensityPCTransformer component that processes PointCloud2 messages. The flaw is due to improper validation of user-supplied data, leading to an out-of-bounds read. Network-adjacent attackers can exploit this without authentication to cause a denial-of-service condition.
